name: tolou-concrete-qc
description: Tolou Concrete QC — offline Windows concrete quality-control suite

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-electron-assets.mjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-electron-assets.mjs
scripts.check: node --check src/domain/sampling.js && node --check src/domain/records.js && node --check src/application/laboratory.js && node --check src/application/projects.js && node --check src/application/engineering.js && node --check src/application/qc-parties.js && node --check src/application/attachments.js && node --check src/application/specimen-physics.js && node --check src/application/fresh-concrete.js && node --check src/application/analytics.js && node --check src/infrastructure/sqlite/migrate.js && node --check scripts/copy-electron-assets.mjs
